title: Not NonStick, Warps Easily, Easy Cleanup
text: Not NonStick, Warps Easily, Easy Cleanup. So so.  Still use them but wouldn’t buy again.  Great price but you get what you pay for.  These are NOT non-stick pans and they warp quickly (we don’t put them in the dishwasher and we don’t wash them until they’ve cooled).  As long as you use lots of cooking spray or butter or whatever, THEN they are non stick.  They do clean  easily for the most part, even with stuck on food.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Classic Nonstick Hard-Anodized 14-Piece Cookware Set, Grey
features: Dual-layer nonstick for easy food release, and quick cleanup
Convenient measuring marks, pour spouts & straining lids save time
Cast stay-cool stainless steel long handles
Oven safe up to 450 degrees F
Compatible with gas, electric, halogen, and glass cooktops
description: The Calphalon Classic Nonstick 14-Piece Cookware Set features pots and pans with convenient fill lines, straining covers, and pour spouts that save time in the kitchen. This set helps eliminate the need to use or clean additional cookware such as measuring cups, strainers, or colanders. Pans are made with dual-layer nonstick for extra-easy food release and cleanup, and are constructed from durable hard-anodized aluminum for fast and even heating. Long, cast stainless steel handles stay cool while cooking on the stove top and the entire nonstick cookware set is oven safe up to 450 degrees F, making it easy to finish recipes or keep food warm until it's served. The nonstick Calphalon cookware set includes an essential assortment of cookware for your kitchen so it’s ideal for everyday cooking.
